# Generated source cache

`BladeBreath > Art > Create Humanoid Sandbox` extracts the bundled archive into
`Extracted/`. That FBX and its metadata are reproducible, ignored by Git, and
editor-only. Twelve selected runtime slots, derived from seven source takes, are copied to standalone `.anim` assets
under `Art/Characters/Generated/Animations/`.

Do not edit the extracted FBX. Keep adjustments in the generated clips and visual
prefabs. The setup menu preserves existing generated assets and scene edits.
